excerpt: Developers can drive Sai from their own code or coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) with the Sai API: send a task in plain language, and Sai completes it on a cloud Windows computer.
Standalone simulang CLI, simulang-js, and the /simulang skill in Claude Code.
collects community-built automations — a 2048 bot, a Wordle solver, a Calendar-to-Docs digest, a TikTok forwarder, and more — each one a small, runnable script you can clone and adapt
An open-source framework for agents that control computers like a human — UI, keyboard, and mouse — across environments.
Coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) use it through the `@simular-ai/sai-mcp` MCP server.
Interfaces: `POST /v1/agents/message` over HTTPS, a Python SDK, and the `@simular-ai/sai-mcp` MCP server
Run a workflow once and Sai can save it as code: later runs replay that code and ask the model only where the screen matters, which cuts tokens by up to 90% on repetitive tasks
Reliability: saved code heals itself. When a step breaks because the UI changed, the agent takes over from there.
Save this as a replayable skill named invoice_export, with vendor and month as parameters.
Models: model-agnostic. You choose the model Sai plans with.
If Sai asks before a step, the stream sends `data-approval-request` and waits: when `isLinkOnly` is `false`, answer it from another terminal with `POST /v1/agents/approve`
You need to see what a real user sees: testing a sign-up flow, reproducing a bug report.
There is no API, or the API doesn't cover the task: vendor portals, admin consoles, legacy web apps.
A Windows or Linux cloud computer that Simular hosts, or your own Mac or Windows PC. On Pay as you go, up to 5 cloud computers can run at the same time.
Optional: install the Sai skill, which teaches Claude Code the task loop.
Give it a task in plain English. It looks at the screen and completes the task by clicking, typing, and scrolling in ordinary desktop and web apps.
you describe the work in plain English and Sai does it on a cloud computer or your own device, asking for approval before sensitive steps
Teach it once, and Sai reruns on a schedule, getting more reliable and cost-efficient each time.
Sai continues after you close the laptop. Get notified via iMessage and Telegram when it needs you.
Watch your Sai computers work. Nothing in the blackbox. Sit back and enjoy full transparency.
Sai works across your entire operating system: desktop apps, web browsers, file systems, and terminals, the way a human would.
Your setup, logins, preferences, and context persist between sessions.
Sai's BYOD supports devices including Mac mini, macOS and Windows. Users can download Sai to get it running on their own device environment with control and privacy.
Sai supports skills, so you can extend how it works for different tasks and workflows... the most effective skill shared across a team.
approve its critical steps and get results on the go via iMessage, SMS, or Telegram.
Safety model: Sai asks for human approval before sensitive or irreversible actions (for example sending, paying, deleting).
Robostaff Marketplace: ready-made Sai workflows by job function
You don’t need to be technical, and you don’t need an API: if you can click it, Sai can.
Zero setup. Sai starts using your favorite apps right away
Legacy in-app JavaScript-style actions for a deprecated desktop automation surface. Kept for reference and migration only.
